mapper.select: select id, prop_type, prop_name from prop where id=#{id} and status=1 and prop_type in (1,2,4,6,7,11)
select id, prop_type, prop_name from prop where id in #{id} and status=1 and prop_type in (1,2,4,6,7,11)
select id, prop_type, prop_name from prop where id in #{id}

select p.id,p.prop_type,p.prop_name from user_noble_config c join prop p on p.id in (c.avatar_box,c.entry_show,c.enter_room_effect,c.bubble_box,c.profile_card) where c.noble_level=#{vipLevel} and c.region_id=#{regionId} and p.status=1
select count(1) from user_noble_config where noble_level=#{vipLevel} and region_id=#{regionId}
mapper.update: update user_purse set gold_num=gold_num+#{amount} where uid=#{uid}
mapper.select: select gold_num from user_purse where uid=#{uid}
mapper.insert: insert into bill_gold(uid,create_time,type,gold_num,country,order_id,bill_type,remark,region_id) select #{uid},now(),1,#{amount},country,#{orderId},2,#{remark},#{regionId} from `user` where uid=#{uid}

insert into user_noble(uid,noble_level,open_time,expired_time,bug_coin,region_id) values(#{receiverUid},#{vipLevel},now(),date_add(now(),interval #{dayNum} day),0,#{regionId}) on duplicate key update expired_time=date_add(if(expired_time>now(),expired_time,now()),interval #{dayNum} day),update_time=now()
